title: Fable 5.2 finally helped me ship something.
author: MaqeSweden
selftext:
I wanted to make a bit of fun of myself for never shipping anything that I build so I decided to make something I could ship quickly.

I used Fable 5.2 with subagents in a gauntlet loop plus MCP connections to Elevenlabs and Adobe for sound.

I set the prompt and had it ask me a few questions last night before getting started and just checked in on it at lunch today and was pleasantly surprised by how it turned out.

I have been vibecoding since this summer but most of my stuff are either too big to ever get finished or too niche to really show, so I decided to make a little game that makes a bit of fun of me and the vibecoding trend in general.

Totally free to play of course, no cookies just a scoreboard if you want to leave a trace. It's supposed to be able to tell if it's a human or an ai bot playing - not sure I will find out if that works.

Let me know if you think it's fun or funny, or both.

[https://shipit-pinball.pages.dev/](https://shipit-pinball.pages.dev/)

Yes, I obviously made a huge effort on the domain too.
